name: @utdk/deepgram
description: Deepgram streaming speech-to-text provider for @utdk/stt. Credential: a bearer_token holding a Deepgram API key (UTDK injects Authorization: Bearer; the driver sends Token to Deepgram).

schemes.description: Deepgram API key. The UTDK executor injects Authorization: Bearer; this module translates that to Deepgram's Token scheme on the listen WebSocket.
